pages.title: Looping Over Items
pages.content: A `for` loop iterates over a sequence (like a list, string, or range). Use `range()` to loop a specific number of times.

pages.title: For Loop Examples
Quick Check
pages.question: What does `range(3)` produce?
pages.explanation: range(3) starts at 0 and goes up to (but not including) 3.
